item.title: Show HN: Mooneva Cycle – Offline period tracker with no servers and no accounts
item.summary: Data stays encrypted on your device (PBKDF2/AES-GCM), no internet permission, nothing to breach or subpoena. GPL-3.0, TypeScript/React + Capacitor. Android & iOS. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49277194 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
